notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
Impliment a single save system.
The UI tooltip flickering problem fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Panzer Commander v1.1.0 demo now is avaliable.Some adjustments have been made.The realease version is coming soon.
 Here’s the list of changes included in this update:

The damage of rocket is strengthened and the error of rocket damage calculation is solved.
The Bug causing stuck has been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
In our demo，I added the tooltips to help you understand the concepts.Also, some adjustments have been made to the UI of tutorials.
Here’s the list of changes included in this update:

Added tooltips for the dock panel.
Added introduction button of tutorials to show or hide the introduction panel.
Adjust the size of introduction panel in tutorials.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1
notes.content:
In our demo,some issue had been fixed these days.And I adjusted attribute values of characters.
A new level "Montcornet" in "France" is available.Try it!
Here's the list of fixes included in this update:

Cannot switch the order from "attack" to "move" by UI button.
Enter a level and then back to menu and then enter the previous level, the damage numbers and VFXs are missing.
When a "carrier" load unit at original position, it cannot move again.
The second weapon damage calculation is incorrect when panzer attacks artillery.
